requirements.text: The judge refuses a report whose digest does not match the one printed to stderr by sideeye or read from sideeye's stdout, to prevent the agent-built binary from overwriting the report before the judge reads it, so loop_closed could rest on a verdict the subject supplied, and the judge's verdict on

sourceRefs.quote: the eval container's replay report is written where the agent-built binary can overwrite it before the judge reads it

requirements.text: The judge reads the eval container's outputs only from its stdout, to prevent the agent-built binary from rewriting the replay report, its rc, or the functional gate's status or export, and refuses rather than judging if the agent-built binary rewrites any of those files

sourceRefs.quote: nothing the agent can edit is trusted

requirements.text: Sideeye prints the report's digest to stderr, and the judge compares it with the digest of the report read from the file, to prevent the agent-built binary from overwriting the report before the judge reads it

sourceRefs.quote: sideeye replay --json learns to print the report's digest to stderr

requirements.text: The container runs timew as a different uid from sideeye, and the output directory is writable only by sideeye, to prevent the agent-built binary from overwriting the report before the judge reads it

sourceRefs.quote: the container runs timew as a different uid from sideeye and the output directory is writable by sideeye alone

requirements.text: The judge reads the eval container's outputs from its stdout, and counts each token exactly once, requiring exactly one token, to prevent the agent-built binary from rewriting the replay report, its rc, or the functional gate's status or export

sourceRefs.quote: each token counted wherever it appears, exactly one required
